title: Outcome fixation
summary: The player overweights score, rank, or one bad run and under-reviews the repeatable execution errors that actually need fixing.
telltales: Session reflection stays at the level of score emotion instead of movement pattern review
One poor benchmark attempt changes the player's entire judgment of progress
contraindications: Do not pretend outcome never matters at all, because benchmarks still help track change
avoid: Reviewing a session with only PBs, ranks, and frustration
